comparison.objective: Hand-place three SMD parts on pads to IPC Class 3, with the tantalum polarity band on the positive pad.
comparison.physical_skill: Microscale grasping, polarity recognition, planar alignment, and gentle placement versus microscale coaxial tool alignment, bimanual impact, and fragment retrieval.
